description: Import records in bulk from CSV or an array of objects. For the 'records' array ALWAYS use field IDs as keys.

csv_text.description: CSV text with headers in the first row. Commas and semicolons are both taken as separators. Example: "Name,Email,Status\nJohn,john@ex.com,New"

records.description: Array of objects whose keys are the form's field IDs (not names!). An alternative to csv_text. Example: [{"dcTrJdP1bppyk3vCkKvCoN": "John"}]

name: import_records
